component.name: DropTerm
component.summary: A drop-down terminal panel applet for the COSMIC™ desktop

description.p: Panel applet companion to DropTerm: one click on the panel button toggles the drop-down terminal overlay, and the button shows at a glance whether the terminal is running.

The applet drives the DropTerm terminal over the session bus. The terminal itself is native-only — a sandboxed client gets no layer shell on cosmic-comp — so install it from the project's GitHub release; this applet is the store-listed entry point.
First listing in the COSMIC Flatpak source, tracking DropTerm 0.2.0.
